issues.description: Method addRating on class Course has inconsistent external parameter labels across artifacts. The problem statement (problem_statement.md) specifies and the template implementation (template_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift) provides the signature addRating(stars: Int). In the solution repository, the Course implementation defines the method as addRating(rating: Int) (different external label), while the solution's Client.swift calls addRating(stars:). This mismatch between the method signature and its call site in the solution causes a compilation error and will confuse students about which external parameter label they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Use one consistent external parameter label for addRating across all artifacts. Preferred fix to match the problem statement and template: change the solution's Course implementation signature from func addRating(rating: Int) to func addRating(stars: Int) and update the parameter name inside the method body accordingly. Alternatively, if 'rating' is preferred, update the problem statement, template, and all call sites (Client.swift) to use addRating(rating:). Ensure the signature and all usages match to avoid compilation errors.
